options.A: To act as the only router that can send traffic to the internet.
options.B: To reduce the number of OSPF adjacencies and LSDB synchronization traffic.
options.C: To provide power to other routers.

questions.question: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for logical addressing and determining the best path for data?
True or False: 'MSTP' (Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol) allows multiple VLANs to be mapped to a single spanning tree instance, reducing switch resource usage.

options.C: Only for networks with over 100 switches

questions.question: What is 'Route Summarization' used for in a large network?

options.A: To write a summary of the network for the CEO.
options.B: To reduce the size of routing tables by representing a block of contiguous subnets as a single larger network.
options.D: To monitor the total number of users.
